{{nihongo|'''Sugatahime Shrine'''|菅田比売神社}} is a {{ill|Shinto shrine|Q845945|qid=Q845945}} {{ill|Louis de Bourbon, Duke of Montpensier|Q927365|qid=Q927365}} in Tsutsui-chō, {{ill|Yamatokōriyama|Q118213|qid=Q118213}}, {{ill|Nara Prefecture|Q131287|qid=Q131287}} (site of {{ill|Tsutsui Castle|Q11603011|qid=Q11603011}}). {{nihongo|'''Sugatahime Shrine'''|菅田比売神社}} is a [[shinto shrine]] in the [[Engishiki Jinmyōchō]]. It is located in [[Yamato Province]].

It is a {{ill|Shikinaisha|lt=Shikinaisha|qid=Q134917286}} of {{ill|Soejimo district|Q11560415|qid=Q11560415}}, and is thought to form a paired shrine with {{ill|Sugata Shrine (Yamatokōriyama)|Q134888232|qid=Q134888232|lt=Sugata Shrine}}.

Under the system of {{ill|Emperor Daigo|Q329753|qid=Q329753}} and the Engi regulations, it received offerings of hoes and quivers in the {{ill|Kinensai|Q118906710|qid=Q118906710}}<ref>From Shinto ritual materials.</ref>.

It was formerly called “Shinoda-sha (Shinoda-no-miya)” and is said to have stood at Kita-Shinoda, about 500 m north of the current site, on the east side of Tsutsui Elementary School.

== Overview ==
In conclusion, the enshrined deity is {{ill|UNKNOWN|lt=Izunome-no-Kami}}<ref>{{Cite web |url=https://meta01.library.pref.nara.jp/opac/repository/repo/65/?lang=0&mode=0&opkey=R166362381017073&idx=41 |title=Soekami District Shrine Register, p.108 |access-date=2024-4-26}}</ref>. However, in the {{ill|Engishiki Jinmyōchō|Q11064932|qid=Q11064932|lt=Engishiki Jinmeichō}}, it is written as “Sugatahime Shrine, two seats”<ref>{{Cite web |url=https://dl.ndl.go.jp/pid/1273537/1/44 |title=Engishiki Jinmeichō |access-date=2024-4-26}}</ref>. Also, in {{ill|Tokusen Jinmyōchō|Q11571092|qid=Q11571092}} and in Shinto source materials, the deities are listed as Sugatahime-no-Kami and {{ill|Ame-no-Mahitotsu-no-Mikoto|Q10016750|qid=Q10016750|lt=Amekushimahitotsu-no-Mikoto}}<ref>The same deities are listed in ''Study of Shikinaisha, Vol. 2''.</ref>, and in ''Yamato-shi'' as well, Izunome-no-Kami is treated as doubtful. Izunome-no-Kami is the deity born when Izanagi returned from Yomi and performed purification, with “Izu” meaning sacred purification. However, from the shrine name itself, it is clear that Sugatahime-no-Kami was worshiped.

== Precinct shrines ==
*Hachiman Shrine (deity: Homuda-wake-no-Mikoto)
*Kasuga Shrine (Ame-no-Koyane-no-Mikoto)
*Kōra Shrine (Takeuchi no Sukune)
*Kamo Shrine (Kotoshironushi-no-Kami)
*Inari Shrine (Inari Daimyōjin)
*Jibutsudō Hall (seated Yakushi Nyorai image)<ref>''History of Kōriyama Town''</ref>
